answer: A Dedicated device bound by DNS record proof with revocation on transfer ties the identity to something the applicant actually controls: the dedicated device answers a fresh challenge, the DNS record proof is recorded, and revocation on transfer keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so a Sybil farm would need a separate real channel for every fake account. A pigment that appears twice is the tell: the same channel cannot back two identities. When the prism settles over the lotus, the binding holds because every channel answered its own challenge.
